transcript-created.title: Transcript created
transcript-created.description: One successfully transcribed file with SRT, VTT, TXT and JSON outputs (primary event). Failed files are free.

audio-minute.title: Audio minute transcribed
audio-minute.description: Per started minute of transcribed audio with tiny, base or small (and .en variants). Up to 0.5 s of padding is ignored when rounding.

audio-minute-hq.title: Audio minute transcribed (HQ model)
audio-minute-hq.description: Per started minute of transcribed audio with large-v3-turbo. Charged instead of audio-minute, never in addition. Up to 0.5 s of padding is ignored when rounding.
